notes: The Jardim Botanico: the palm avenue and fountain outside and the orchid house inside, each in two states (start, full) and three looks (day, rain, night). Bases ship without stickers, Esme or Bebe.
role: mornings with morning pages fill it with orchids and potted plants (the 'greenhouse' family, 'Orchid house'); weeks with a habit ticked add trees (the 'trees' family). Nothing is ever removed.

looks.night: after sunset in Rio until sunrise (rain at night shows night)

locations.name: Jardim Botanico: the palm avenue and fountain

stickerAccepts.trees:tree: a Trees tree (imperial palm, yellow ipe, jabuticaba, pau-brasil sapling, bamboo clump)
stickerAccepts.greenhouse:plant: an Orchid house plant (orchid, bromeliad, moth orchid, cattleya, anthurium, bird-of-paradise, fern basket)
stickerAccepts.greenhouse:water: an Orchid house water plant (Victoria water lily)

stickerNote: kind comes from the sticker manifest's 'kind'; the existing family stickers live in art/final/rio-pack/day1/stickers/, the new ones in stickers/ here
